events.invalidation: Exit if the SOFR versus CORRA advantage compresses sharply toward or through the already-narrower March strip, or if a sustained oil-and-risk bid reverses the dollar against Canada while United States rates stop supporting the long.
events.rationale: United States cash and March strip rates still dominate Canada by more than a point and a half, so the dollar versus the loonie remains the cleanest hold of that gap. A cross or an oil-tied Canada expression would add crude and risk beta the rate story does not need. Expensive crude and a quiet equity tape can slow further dollar gains, which is why this is a hold of the existing long rather than an add. Keep the view in dollar spot until that policy advantage actually closes.
